Import the purchases Stripe or a payment source recorded before Voidhash was connected, in the
background. Running it again skips what is recorded; --watch follows it, --cancel stops it.

Usage:
  voidhash provider import [provider] [flags]

Arguments:
  provider  The provider: app-store, google-play, stripe, a payment source's slug or name, or its id

Flags:
      --cancel             Stop the running import instead; what it recorded stays
      --environment <production|test>
                           Which purchases: production (default) or test, such as Stripe's test mode
                           or a payment source's test payments
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --watch              Follow the import until it ends

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider import stripe --watch
  voidhash provider import paddle --environment test
  voidhash provider import stripe --cancel
